script.title: QUESTIONING A PHONE BILL
script.scene_zh: 電話客服 · 詢問帳單
script.story_hook: A customer questions a strange charge on his bill.
script.intro_zh: 顧客針對帳單上一筆奇怪的費用提出質問。
script.welcome_en: Hello again, everyone! Today we're fixing a phone bill problem.
script.welcome_zh: 各位，又見面了！今天我們來處理電話帳單的問題。
script.outro: That's all for today! Read your bills carefully now.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！現在開始，記得仔細看帳單喔。
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn, repeat each line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你，一句一句跟著唸。

script.char_b_description: a polished woman in her forties with dark brown hair in a sleek low bun, wearing a plum blouse and a slim headset, typing on her keyboard while she reassures the caller
script.youtube_title: 【📱帳單多扣錢怎麼辦】「這筆我沒印象」怎麼說？🧾申訴・退費句型聽完就會用✨｜Phone Bill English
script.youtube_title_en: "A Charge I Don't Recognize" — Questioning a Phone Bill
script.youtube_description:
帳單上冒出一筆沒買過的服務，該怎麼辦？這集跟著 Kevin 打一通完整的客服電話：報帳號、指出異常費用、問清楚什麼是按比例計費、把錢要回來變成下月額度。整段 18 句自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完你的帳單問題自己搞定！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英文變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
There's a charge on your bill for something you never ordered — now what? Follow Kevin through one complete customer service call: giving the account number, pointing out the strange charge, learning what prorated means, and getting the money back as next month's credit. 18 lines of natural American English with IPA and translations, plus a repeat-after-me section to lock the phrases in.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】📱帳單英文｜異常費用・加值服務・額度退回｜聽完就會打客服｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
打開手機帳單，多了一筆完全沒印象的費用？
用英文打客服，第一句話要怎麼開口？

這一集帶大家走進一通週一傍晚的客服電話，跟著 Kevin 從報上帳號開始，指出那筆九塊九九的音樂加值、問懂按比例計費，最後把錢退成下個月的額度。

你會聽到：
🧾 指出問題：例如「I have a question about my latest phone bill.」、「There's a charge I don't recognize」。
🎵 來回確認：例如「I never signed up for anything like that!」、「So could you please remove it right away?」。
💰 退費與額度：例如「Part of it is prorated, by the way.」、「The money returns as bill credit.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把打電話申訴的英文練順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次帳單不對，你自己一通電話就能搞定！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a printed phone bill while on a call

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I have a question about my latest phone bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ hæv ə ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈleɪtəst foʊn bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想請教關於最新一期電話帳單的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, happy to help. Can I have your account number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ˈhæpi tə hɛl p kæn aɪ hæv jɔr əˈkaʊnt ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 好的，很樂意為您服務。請問帳單號碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's 4471, then my last name, Nguyen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈfɔr ˈfɔr ˈsɛvən wʌn ðɛn maɪ læst neɪm nuˈjɛn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, Kevin. I see the bill right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ˈkɛvɪn aɪ si ðə bɪl raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 感謝，凱文。我看到這期的帳單了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a charge I don't recognize, nine ninety-nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə tʃɑrdʒ aɪ doʊnt ˌrɛkəɡˈnaɪz naɪn ˈnɪnti naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 有一筆費用我沒印象，九塊九毛九。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, that looks like a music add-on service.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðæt lʊks laɪk ə ˈmjuːzɪk ˈædˌɑn ˈsɜrvəs/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那看起來是一項音樂加值服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I never signed up for anything like that!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈnɛvər saɪnd ʌp fər ˈɛniθɪŋ laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 我根本沒有訂閱過這種東西啊！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I believe you. Let me see when it started.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliv ju lɛt mi si wɛn ɪt ˈstɑrtəd/
dialogue.zh: 我相信您。讓我看看它是哪天加的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The note says it was added on the fifteenth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə noʊt sɛz ɪt wəz əˈdæd ɑn ðə fɪfˈtinθ/
dialogue.zh: 上面寫著，它是十五號加上去的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're right, that was added by mistake, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr raɪt ðæt wəz əˈdæd baɪ mɪsˈteɪk ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，這是誤加的，我們很抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So could you please remove it right away?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kʊd ju pliz rɪˈmuv ɪt raɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那麻煩您現在就把它移除，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done! Part of it is prorated, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn pɑrt ɑv ɪt ɪz proʊˈreɪtəd baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 處理好了！順帶一提，費用是按比例算的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Prorated? What does that mean, exactly?
dialogue.zh: 按比例？確切地說是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You only pay for days you actually had it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈoʊnli peɪ fər deɪz ju ˈæktʃuəli hæd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 您只需要支付實際使用的那幾天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah okay. I already paid that month, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ˈoʊkeɪ aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi peɪd ðæt mʌnθ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 啊，懂了。不過那個月的費用我已經繳了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, the money returns as bill credit.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜriz ðə ˈmʌni rɪˈtɜrnz æz bɪl ˈkrɛdɪt/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，那筆錢會以帳面額度退回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So next month I just pay less, right? Thanks!
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ nɛkst mʌnθ aɪ dʒʌst peɪ lɛs raɪt θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 所以下個月我少付一點，對嗎？謝謝！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly that! Take care now, have a good one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt teɪk kɛr naʊ hæv ə ɡʊd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 一點沒錯！祝您有美好的一天，再見。
